intent: A standard-width share dialog: invite people by email, set the access scope, and manage each person's role; an optional stacked card exposes Export.
guidance: Handlers double as capability gates. Omit onScopeChange and the access-scope row is static, not a menu; omit onChangeAccess/onRemovePerson and a person's role shows as plain text; omit onRevokeInvitation and pending rows read "pending" instead of offering Revoke. Pass onExport only when the host owns an export flow — it switches the Modal to stacked and adds a second card with an Export cell, since export is a peer of sharing, not a rename of it. variant only swaps the header copy (project vs team). Left unwired, people falls back to an internal single-owner demo roster and edits stay local — pass people to control it. Use inviteHint to explain why invitation is disabled.

anatomy.description: A 480px Modal card (MODAL_WIDTHS.standard) with backdrop: bg-c-bg, rounded-c-lg, shadow-c-500. When onExport is set the Modal goes stacked, painting each ModalCard separately with an 8px gap.

ModalHeader (h-40, border-b border-c-border): title left ("Share this project" / "Invite to team" per variant, or the title prop), a "Copy link" Link button, then the close X. Title binds to the Radix DialogTitle.
Corner dismiss button (aria-label "Close"); a backdrop click and Escape also call onClose.

A large email InputField (autoFocus, placeholder "Add emails, names, or user groups") beside a Primary "Invite" button, disabled while the field is empty or inviteDisabled. An inviteHint line renders below when disabled.
A body-medium secondary section label above the access rows.
A 36px ShareRow: Users icon + scopeLabel + trailing "can access". Becomes a menu (ChevronRight, aria-haspopup="menu") opening checkmark scope options when onScopeChange is wired, else static.
A 36px ShareRow per person: Avatar + name (+ muted "(you)"). Trailing is static "owner" text for the owner, otherwise a RoleMenu opening Can edit / Can view / (divider) / Remove (destructive).
A 36px ShareRow per unaccepted invite: grey Avatar + email + muted "(pending)". Trailing is a Revoke Link button when onRevokeInvitation is wired, else static "pending".
Only when onExport is set: a second stacked ModalCard beneath the share card holding one 36px Export cell (Download icon + ChevronRight, aria-haspopup="dialog").

use_when: Sharing a project or team: invite by email and manage who has access and at what level.
You want Export offered as a peer of sharing in the same surface — pass onExport for the stacked actions card.
dont_use_when: A blocking, destructive confirm — use DeleteConfirmDialog.
A transient, non-blocking message with an action — use a Notification toast.
A single-input prompt or plain form with no roster — use a compact Modal.

layout: stacked (adds the Export actions card when onExport is set)

states: invite disabled (capability-gated; input + Invite disabled, optional inviteHint below)
person: owner (static "owner") vs editable role menu
stacked (Export actions card present when onExport is set)

tokens.note: ShareModal's own JSX is fully token-bound (c-* / var(--composa-*)) with no hex. Row and label geometry is hardcoded px for Figma fidelity (rows h-36, leading slot size-24, header h-40, insets px-16 py-8, stack gap 8). The only non-token color is the Modal backdrop scrim, a hardcoded rgba(0,0,0,0.4) (special/modalbackdrop) owned by Modal, not this component.

a11y.role: dialog — Radix Dialog.Content (via Modal) supplies role=dialog + aria-modal, a focus trap, and Escape-to-close; the header title binds to the Radix DialogTitle for the accessible name.
a11y.close: The header X is a real <button aria-label="Close">; a backdrop click and Escape also call onClose.
a11y.scope: When onScopeChange is wired the access-scope row is a <button aria-label="Change who can access" aria-haspopup="menu"> opening checkmark rows.
a11y.roleMenu: Each editable person's role trigger sets aria-haspopup="menu" and opens Can edit / Can view / Remove (destructive) rows.
a11y.export: When onExport is wired the Export cell is a <button aria-label="Export" aria-haspopup="dialog">.
a11y.note: aria-describedby is intentionally undefined (from Modal). Owner rows and non-revocable pending rows render as static text, not controls.

code.example:
<ShareModal
  open={open}
  onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
  variant="project"
  people={people}
  onInvite={email => invite(email)}
  onChangeAccess={(id, access) => setAccess(id, access)}
  onRemovePerson={id => remove(id)}
/>
